name: Densha Girl
source:
Densha Girl is a game made (mostly) in 24 hours by NewWestGames and other contributors from the Beam.pro community.

It follows the story of Hana, a delinquent at school who rarely goes in. Whenever she does though, she sees a beautiful blonde girl on her way home every day.

[From [url=https://newwestgames.itch.io/denshagirl]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Densha Girl是一款（大部分）由NewWestGames和Beam.pro社区的其他贡献者在24小时内制作的游戏。

故事讲述了哈娜（Hana）的故事，她是一名学校不良学生，很少去学校。但每当她回家时，她每天都会在回家的路上看到一个美丽的金发女孩。

[来自[url=https://newwestgames.itch.io/denshagirl]itch.io[/url]]
